AdminOps.auditEmptyBody: No audit entry matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.auditIntro: What was changed, when, and in which table. It records which columns changed, not what they changed to.
AdminOps.awaitingContactHint: Waiting for the person to confirm their new contact with a one-time code. That step is theirs, not yours.
AdminOps.catalogueIntro: Every role, what it carries and how many people currently hold it. Reference only.
AdminOps.completionConfirm: Finish this recovery? Their sessions end immediately and the hold starts.
AdminOps.completionIntro: This ends every session on the account and holds withdrawals and payout changes for the configured period.
AdminOps.confirmClose: Close this storefront? This is final: there is no reopen from here.
AdminOps.confirmReinstate: Reinstate this storefront? It becomes visible again, along with its listings.
AdminOps.confirmSuspend: Suspend this storefront? It and every listing on it stop being publicly visible straight away, and the seller can no longer edit anything.
AdminOps.conflict: Somebody has already moved this on. Reload to see where it stands.
AdminOps.cursorBody: The address carried a position that is no longer usable. Start again from the first page.
AdminOps.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
AdminOps.decisionConfirm: Record this decision? It cannot be retaken.
AdminOps.decisionIntro: Approving moves it on to confirming the person's new contact. Rejecting closes it.
AdminOps.evidenceIntro: What was sent in support of this request. The files themselves are not readable from here.
AdminOps.failed: That could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
AdminOps.isReviewerHint: You reviewed this request, so somebody else has to decide it.
AdminOps.needsAnother: Somebody other than you has to decide this one.
AdminOps.noStepHint: There is nothing to do on this request right now.
AdminOps.notFoundBody: This is not something you can open. It may not exist, or it may not be yours to see.
AdminOps.ownRequestHint: This is your own account. Somebody else has to handle it.
AdminOps.reasonHint: Required when suspending. It is kept while the suspension lasts and cleared when the storefront is reinstated.
AdminOps.recoveryDetailIntro: One recovery request, its evidence, and the one step you can take on it.
AdminOps.recoveryEmptyBody: No recovery request matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.recoveryIntro: People locked out of their accounts, oldest first. Every decision here is taken by two different people, and never by the account holder.
AdminOps.reviewConfirm: Record your review of this request? You will not be able to decide it afterwards.
AdminOps.reviewIntro: Confirm that you have checked the documents against the claim. This fixes you as the reviewer, and somebody else will have to take the decision.
AdminOps.roleAboveCeiling: That role is above your own, so you cannot grant or withdraw it.
AdminOps.roleAlreadyRevoked: That role has already been withdrawn.
AdminOps.roleExpiresHint: Leave empty for a grant that does not expire. Must be in the future. Granting the same role again is how you change this.
AdminOps.roleExpiryInvalid: The expiry must be in the future.
AdminOps.roleFailed: The role could not be changed. Try again.
AdminOps.roleGrantConfirm: Grant this role to this account? Press Grant role again to confirm.
AdminOps.roleIsSelf: You cannot change your own roles.
AdminOps.roleNotAssignable: That role cannot be assigned to an account.
AdminOps.roleNotGrantable: That role cannot be granted or withdrawn from the console.
AdminOps.roleNothingToDo: You hold no role high enough to grant or withdraw anything on this account.
AdminOps.roleReasonHint: Recorded with the change. Required for both granting and withdrawing.
AdminOps.roleRevokeConfirm: Withdraw this role? Give a reason, then press Withdraw again to confirm.
AdminOps.roleSessionNote: Withdrawing a role does not sign the account out. It stops applying the next time they make a request, so a session already open keeps working until then.
AdminOps.roleWriteIntro: Grant a role to this account, or withdraw one it holds. Only the roles you may grant are offered; the list comes from your own roles and is decided on the server.
AdminOps.rolesReadOnlyNote: Granting and removing roles is not available here: no authoritative writer for role assignment exists in this system yet, and the rules for one — which roles may be granted by whom, what happens to live sessions when one is removed — have not been agreed.
AdminOps.sellerDetailIntro: One storefront, as an administrator reads it. It shows how the storefront stands and none of the owner's personal or contact details.
AdminOps.sellerTerminalNote: This storefront is closed. Closing is final here: there is no reopen, and nothing on this screen can change its status.
AdminOps.sellerVerificationNote: Verification is decided on the seller verification screen, not here. Activating a pending storefront follows its verification approval.
AdminOps.sellersEmptyBody: Nothing matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.sellersIntro: Storefronts on the marketplace, newest first. This screen reads: nothing here changes a storefront's status, because no authoritative writer for it exists yet.
AdminOps.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
AdminOps.statusIntro: Only the moves this storefront can legally make are offered. Suspending it hides the storefront and every listing on it immediately; closing it is final.
AdminOps.statusNotAllowed: That move is not available for this storefront. Reload to see where it stands.
AdminOps.userDetailIntro: One account, with the roles and the security record an administrator may read.
AdminOps.usersEmptyBody: Nothing matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.usersIntro: Accounts on the marketplace, newest first. Whether each contact channel was confirmed is shown; the contact itself is not.

Attributes.answerCount: {count, plural, =0 {No answers} one {# answer} other {# answers}}
Attributes.attached: This category now asks for it.
Attributes.attachedButHidden: Hidden, so nobody is asked it
Attributes.categoryCount: {count, plural, =0 {No categories ask it} one {# category asks it} other {# categories ask it}}
Attributes.categoryNote: The attributes sellers are asked about a listing in this category. Required is advisory for now: the field is marked and nothing refuses a listing for want of an answer.
Attributes.categoryReadOnlyNote: You can read what this category asks. Changing it needs permission to manage categories.
Attributes.createNote: The name and the kind of answer are fixed once given, because every answer already stored is typed by them. A new attribute is created hidden.
Attributes.createTagNote: The address is fixed once given. A tag is created ready to use.
Attributes.dataTypeHint: This is what every answer is checked against, and it can never be changed.
Attributes.detached: This category no longer asks for it. Every answer is kept.
Attributes.emptyBody: Nothing has been defined. Until an attribute exists, a category has no questions to ask and a listing carries only its title, description and price.
Attributes.failed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
Attributes.filterableHint: Recorded for later. Nothing filters by it yet.
Attributes.hiddenNow: It is hidden. Every answer is kept.
Attributes.identityNote: The name in the data and the kind of answer cannot be changed: every answer already stored refers to them. Hiding this attribute removes the field from sellers' forms and from public pages, and keeps every answer.
Attributes.invalidBody: That request could not be read.
Attributes.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. This is what every answer is stored against, and it can never be changed.
Attributes.keyTaken: That name is already in use, and a name cannot be changed once it has been given. Choose another.
Attributes.needsOption: Needs an option before it can be shown
Attributes.noCategoryAttributesBody: Sellers here are asked only for a title, a description and a price.
Attributes.noChoices: No attribute has been defined yet, or your access does not reach the vocabulary.
Attributes.noOptionsBody: This attribute cannot be shown until it has at least one option: a seller would be given a field with nothing to choose.
Attributes.noTagsBody: Nothing has been created. Sellers will see no tags to choose from.
Attributes.notAnswerable: That would leave sellers a question they cannot answer, or an answer they cannot give. A list needs at least one option before it is shown, and only a list has options.
Attributes.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address, or your access does not reach it.
Attributes.optionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No options} one {# option} other {# options}}
Attributes.optionValueHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. This is what answers refer to, and it can never be changed.
Attributes.optionsNote: What a seller may choose. An option's value is fixed once given; its labels are not. A hidden option cannot be chosen and stays on the listings that already chose it.
Attributes.pageIntro: An attribute is a question a category asks its sellers: the width of a table, whether a chair is assembled, which material something is made of. The vocabulary is defined here once and attached to as many categories as ask for it. A new attribute is hidden until it is ready, and nothing is ever deleted — hiding an attribute removes the field and keeps every answer.
Attributes.readOnlyNote: You can read this vocabulary. Changing it needs another permission.
Attributes.requiredHint: Sellers are told the field is required. Nothing refuses a listing for want of an answer in this release.
Attributes.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Attributes.settingsNote: Labels, unit and ordering. Not the name sellers' answers are stored against, and not whether it is shown.
Attributes.tagSlugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This is the tag's public address and can never be changed.
Attributes.tagsIntro: A tag is a free label a seller may put on a listing: handmade, vintage, imported. Tags are not a hierarchy and do not replace a category. A tag is usable the moment it exists, and retiring one hides it without touching the listings that already carry it.
Attributes.tagsNote: Every tag, including the hidden ones. The usage count is maintained by the database as listings are tagged.
Attributes.unavailable: The vocabulary could not be read. Please try again shortly.
Attributes.unitHint: Only a number has one. Leave it empty for none.
Attributes.valueNotAllowed: That value is longer or differently shaped than this field allows.
Attributes.vocabularyNote: Every attribute, including the hidden ones, in the order sellers are asked them.

Blog.addIntro: A new post is created as a draft at the address you give it.
Blog.countsBody: Each count is every post filed there, drafts and archived ones included — not only the ones the public can see.
Blog.coverBody: A cover is stored as a path in the media library. The public site does not serve it yet, because there is no media address configured to build a link from.
Blog.coverMediaIdHint: The identifier of an entry in the media library, from CMS → Media. Clear the field and save to detach the cover. Nothing on the public site renders a post cover yet.
Blog.cursorBody: That page link is no longer usable. Start from the first page.
Blog.detailIntro: One post: its state, its text in each language, its tags and the addresses it has had.
Blog.draftNotice: The post is created as a draft and is not visible to anybody until it has been written and published.
Blog.editIntro: None of this publishes or unpublishes the post. That is the next panel.
Blog.emptyBody: Nothing has been written. A new post starts as a draft and goes live only once somebody publishes it.
Blog.featuredHint: Only a published post can be featured, and unpublishing one clears this. Featuring does not move the post up the blog index.
Blog.indexableLabel: Allow search engines to index this post
Blog.invalid: Something in that was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
Blog.listIntro: Newest edit first, whatever state each post is in.
Blog.localeRequired: A published post must have text in at least one language.
Blog.metaTitleHint: What a search engine shows instead of the title. Left empty, the post's own title is used. This is the only place it is set — the SEO metadata section does not cover blog posts.
Blog.nameArHint: Optional. Left empty, the English name is shown to Arabic readers.
Blog.noMatchesBody: No post matches that filter. Clearing it shows everything again.
Blog.notAllowed: That is not an allowed change for this post in its current state.
Blog.notFoundBody: There is no post at that address, or you do not have permission to read it.
Blog.notHereBody: The blog is not in the sitemap, and a post's search-engine title and description come from the post itself rather than from the SEO metadata section. There are no comments, no reactions and no byline picker: the author is whoever created the post.
Blog.notHereTitle: What this section does not do
Blog.pageIntro: The marketplace blog. Posts are written here in English and Arabic, filed under a category and tagged, and published when they are ready.
Blog.previousSlugsBody: Each of these redirects to the current address permanently, and no other post can take one.
Blog.readOnlyBody: Editing the blog needs a separate permission from reading it. Ask an administrator if you need it.
Blog.readOnlyTitle: You can read this post but not change it
Blog.referenceUnknown: Something that refers to no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.
Blog.removeLocaleConfirm: Remove this language from the post? The text is deleted.
Blog.renameHint: Changing this keeps the old address working: it redirects here permanently, and no other post can ever take it.
Blog.replaceNotice: Saving replaces this language entirely, so an emptied box clears what was stored.
Blog.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
Blog.scheduledHint: The post goes live by itself when this moment arrives.
Blog.searchHint: Matched as plain text inside a title or an address, so a % or an _ means itself.
Blog.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
Blog.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. This becomes /blog/your-address.
Blog.slugTaken: That address is already in use, or another post used it before and still redirects from it.
Blog.statusIntro: The only control that puts this post in front of the public, or takes it back.
Blog.tagsEmpty: There are no tags yet. Add one further down the page.
Blog.tagsNotice: Saving replaces the whole set, so unticking everything removes every tag.
Blog.taxonomyIntro: The blog's own categories and tags. They are separate from the catalogue's, and share nothing with them.
Blog.translationsIntro: Each language is written by hand; nothing is translated automatically. A language with no text simply does not exist, and readers asking for it get the other one.
Blog.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed.
Blog.unwrittenBody: This post has no text in any language, so it cannot be published or scheduled. Write it below first.

Categories.clearHint: Leave a field empty to clear it. The name is always required.
Categories.createNote: The address is permanent and cannot be changed afterwards. A new category starts hidden until you name it and show it.
Categories.created: The category was created. It is hidden until you name it and show it.
Categories.emptyBody: Nothing has been created. Until a category exists, no seller can publish a listing and the public catalogue has nothing to show.
Categories.failed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
Categories.invalidBody: That request could not be read.
Categories.nameRequired: Name the category in at least one language first. A category that is shown must keep at least one.
Categories.notFoundBody: There is no category at this address, or your access does not reach it.
Categories.pageIntro: The category tree is what every listing hangs from: a seller cannot publish anything without choosing a category, and the public catalogue shows what is here. A category is created hidden, named in each language, and then shown.
Categories.readOnlyBody: Changing the catalogue needs a further permission, so nothing here can be edited with your access.
Categories.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Categories.shadowed: Shown, but a category above it is hidden, so nobody can reach it.
Categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. This is permanent.
Categories.slugImmutable: The address is permanent. It cannot be changed, because nothing would redirect the old one.
Categories.slugTaken: Another category already uses that address.
Categories.stateNote: This is the only change a visitor notices. Hiding a category hides everything under it, and showing it again brings the branch back exactly as it was.
Categories.treeNotAllowed: That is not an allowed place in the tree. The tree is three levels deep, a category cannot sit under itself or anything below it, and a category with children has to have them moved first.
Categories.treeNote: Every category, including the hidden ones, in the order the public sees them. Up to three levels.
Categories.unavailable: The catalogue could not be read. Please try again shortly.
Categories.unwrittenBody: This category has no name yet, so it cannot be shown. Write at least one language below.
Categories.valueNotAllowed: One of those values is too long.

Cms.bodyHint: Plain text. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
Cms.coverFailed: The cover could not be saved. Try again.
Cms.coverIntro: Attach an image from the media library to this page by its identifier. The library is in CMS → Media, where each entry shows its identifier.
Cms.coverMediaIdHint: The identifier of an entry in the media library. Clear the field and save, or use Remove, to detach the cover.
Cms.coverMediaMissing: That identifier does not name an entry in the media library.
Cms.coverNoneBody: This page has no cover image. Paste a media identifier below to attach one.
Cms.coverNotShownBody: Nothing on the public site renders a page cover. Attaching one records which image belongs to this page; it does not make the image appear anywhere. Serving these images publicly is separate work that has not been built.
Cms.createFailed: The page could not be created.
Cms.createIntro: A new page is always a draft. Write it in at least one language before publishing it.
Cms.cursorBody: That page could not be opened. Start again from the first page.
Cms.detailIntro: One page: its address, its lifecycle and every language it has been written in.
Cms.emptyBody: Nothing has been authored so far.
Cms.indexableLabel: Allow search engines to index this page
Cms.invalid: Please check the fields and try again.
Cms.listIntro: Newest edit first. A page with no language cannot be published.
Cms.localeRequired: The page must be written in at least one language while it is published or scheduled.
Cms.noLocalesBody: This page has no text in any language, so it cannot be published.
Cms.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Cms.pageIntro: The static pages the public site serves — about, help, the policies and the legal pages. Each one is a row here, so adding or renaming a page is an authoring action rather than a deployment.
Cms.pageKeyHint: Optional, stable identifier for a well-known page. Leave empty to clear it.
Cms.previousSlugsNote: Each of these redirects permanently to the current address and can never be reused by another page.
Cms.publicAddressNone: Not served by the public site
Cms.publicAddressNoneBody: The public site serves a fixed set of page addresses. Nothing is wrong with this page, but no visitor can reach it at this slug until the site is given a route for it.
Cms.publicAddressNoneTitle: This page has no public address
Cms.readOnlyBody: You can read this page but not change it.
Cms.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
Cms.settingsFailed: The changes could not be saved.
Cms.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. This becomes the page's URL.
Cms.slugRenameHint: Changing this keeps the old address as a permanent redirect.
Cms.slugTaken: That address is already in use, or was previously used by another page.
Cms.statusFailed: The change could not be applied.
Cms.statusIntro: Publishing, scheduling, archiving and unpublishing. Which changes are allowed is decided by the platform, and a refused change says why.
Cms.transitionNotAllowed: That is not an allowed change for a page in its current state.
Cms.translationFailed: The language could not be saved.
Cms.translationRemoveConfirm: Press again to remove this language.
Cms.translationsIntro: Nothing is machine translated. A language exists because somebody wrote it; a page asked for in a language it lacks is served in English.
Cms.unavailable: This could not be loaded right now. Please try again.

CmsMedia.altTextHint: What the image shows, for anyone who cannot see it. Optional in both languages, and up to 300 characters each.
CmsMedia.bytesFailed: The file could not be uploaded to storage. Nothing was recorded.
CmsMedia.emptyBody: Nothing has been uploaded yet. Use the form above to add the first image.
CmsMedia.fileHint: Chosen from your computer. It is uploaded once you press the button below.
CmsMedia.invalid: Something in the form is not valid. Nothing was changed.
CmsMedia.notAllowed: That file is not allowed. Check the type and the size.
CmsMedia.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for your account.
CmsMedia.notUsedYetBody: The library stores images and this screen previews them. Page covers, blog covers and social share images still cannot display one, and no public image address exists. Using these images on the public site is a separate change somebody has to decide on.
CmsMedia.notUsedYetTitle: Nothing public shows these images yet
CmsMedia.objectMissing: The uploaded file could not be found in storage, so nothing was recorded.
CmsMedia.pageIntro: Images used by site content. Uploads go straight to private storage and are never served publicly — nothing on the public site shows them yet.
CmsMedia.pathTaken: That upload has already been recorded.
CmsMedia.previewFailed: The image could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
CmsMedia.previewHint: This preview link is private and expires after a few minutes. It is not a public address and cannot be shared.
CmsMedia.removeConfirm: Delete this image from the library? Anything listed above will lose it and will need a new one.
CmsMedia.removeFailed: The image could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.
CmsMedia.rulesBody: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB. SVG is not accepted: an SVG can carry scripts, and site imagery has no need to. The file name is chosen by the server, so two uploads never collide and nothing you type becomes part of a path.
CmsMedia.saveFailed: The alt text could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
CmsMedia.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
CmsMedia.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller one.
CmsMedia.unavailable: The library could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
CmsMedia.uploadIntro: The file goes directly to storage; this console records what was stored and where.
CmsMedia.uploadRefused: The upload could not be completed. Nothing was recorded.
CmsMedia.usageFailed: The references could not be loaded, so deleting is not offered. Try again shortly.
CmsMedia.usageNone: Nothing points at this image, so deleting it changes nothing else.
CmsMedia.wrongType: That file type is not accepted. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image.

Console.title: Console
Console.intro: The areas you have access to. Choose one to begin.
Console.languageFailed: The language could not be changed. Try again.
Console.signedOutBody: Sign in with your staff account to continue.
Console.stepUpBody: Staff access needs a second factor. Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
Console.forbiddenBody: This area is not available for your account.
Console.unavailableBody: We could not check your access just now. Try again shortly.
Console.emptyBody: Your account has no console areas. Ask an administrator if you think this is wrong.
Console.comingSoon: The tools for this area arrive in a later step. Nothing is missing from your account.

Disputes.queueIntro: Disputes between a buyer and a seller about one order, oldest first — somebody is out of pocket while a dispute waits.
Disputes.detailIntro: What is claimed and why, the order it is about, and the exchange so far.
Disputes.boundaryNote: Recording a decision here settles the dispute and puts the order back where it was. It does not move money: a refund decision records that a refund is owed, and paying it is a separate step that is not part of this console.
Disputes.deferredNote: Attaching or reading evidence, assigning a dispute and changing its due date are not available yet. Only two dispute states are reachable, so no other state is offered as a filter.
Disputes.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Disputes.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Disputes.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Disputes.failed: That could not be recorded. Try again.
Disputes.conflict: This dispute has changed since the page loaded. Reload it and look again.
Disputes.signedOut: The session has ended. Sign in again.
Disputes.isPartyHint: You are a party to this dispute, so somebody else has to rule on it.
Disputes.isPartyNote: You are the buyer or the seller on this dispute. A colleague who is not a party has to rule on it. You can still add a message.
Disputes.isPartyRefusal: Nobody rules on a dispute they are a party to. A colleague has to take this one.
Disputes.internalIsParty: You are a party to this dispute, so you cannot leave a staff-only note on it. An ordinary message is fine.
Disputes.resolvedByMeHint: You recorded the decision on this dispute.
Disputes.readOnlyNote: You can read this dispute. Adding a message and recording a decision need a further permission.
Disputes.closedNote: This dispute is settled. Its thread is closed and the decision cannot be retaken.
Disputes.messageIntro: A message both parties can read, or a note only staff can see.
Disputes.internalLabel: Staff only — the buyer and the seller cannot see this
Disputes.internalHint: Leave this off and both parties will read it. A staff note is never shown to either of them.
Disputes.confirmVisible: Add this message? The buyer and the seller will both be able to read it, and it cannot be edited or withdrawn.
Disputes.confirmInternal: Add this as a staff-only note? Neither party will see it, and it cannot be edited or withdrawn.
Disputes.threadClosed: This dispute is settled and its thread takes no more messages.
Disputes.refundDecidedNotMoved: This records that a refund is owed. No money has moved: paying it is a separate step that is not part of this console.
Disputes.resolveIntro: Every decision is recorded with its reason, settles the dispute and puts the order back to where it was before. A decision cannot be retaken.
Disputes.noMoneyNotice: This records that a refund is owed. It does not pay it: no refund is created and no money moves. Paying it is a separate step that is not part of this console.
Disputes.reasonHint: Kept with the dispute. Required for every decision.
Disputes.amountHint: Digits only, in the order’s smallest unit — 1500 means 15.00. Optional; leave it empty to record the decision without an amount.
Disputes.amountInvalid: An amount is digits only and greater than zero.
Disputes.confirmRefund: Record this decision? It settles the dispute and puts the order back where it was. It records that a refund is owed and moves no money.
Disputes.confirmRelease: Record this decision? It settles the dispute in the seller’s favour and puts the order back where it was.
Disputes.confirmNoAction: Record this decision? It settles the dispute without finding for either side and puts the order back where it was.
Disputes.alreadyResolved: This dispute has already been settled, either by you or by a colleague. Reload the page.
Disputes.amountNotAllowed: An amount belongs only to a refund decision.

Faqs.addIntro: The English question and answer are required; the Arabic ones are optional and fall back to the English.
Faqs.answerHint: Plain text. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
Faqs.clearArabic: Leave empty to remove the Arabic wording.
Faqs.detailIntro: One question, its answer, and whether any public page shows it.
Faqs.emptyBody: Until a question is written and published, the help pages show their own text and nothing more.
Faqs.listIntro: By topic, then in the order each help page shows them. An unpublished question keeps its place and is shown to nobody.
Faqs.noEntriesBody: No question matches. Add one below, or clear the topic filter.
Faqs.notAllowed: That is not an allowed value for a help-centre entry.
Faqs.notFoundBody: No question here, or none you may open.
Faqs.notHereBody: A question has no image, no search and no structured data here, and it never changes a page's own title or indexing. Writing the page these questions sit under is the static-pages screen.
Faqs.notHereTitle: What this screen does not do
Faqs.notShownBody: No published page carries this topic as its key, so these questions appear nowhere. Give a page that key, or move the question to a topic a page already shows.
Faqs.pageIntro: The questions the site's own help pages answer. A question is shown by whichever published page carries its topic as that page's key — /faq shows the faq topic and /help shows the help topic.
Faqs.previewHint: Plain text, with a new paragraph wherever you left a blank line. Nothing is treated as HTML.
Faqs.removeConfirm: Remove this question and its answer?
Faqs.reorderHint: Move the questions into the order this topic's page should show them, then save.
Faqs.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Try again shortly.
Faqs.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
Faqs.topicHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. A published page with this as its key is what shows the question.
Faqs.topicsIntro: A topic is shown by a published page whose key matches it. Topics are free-form, so one no page carries is kept and simply seen by nobody.
Faqs.unavailable: The help centre could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
Faqs.unpublishedNotice: A new question is saved unpublished. Publishing it is a separate step.
Faqs.unservablePage: The page that shows it has no address on this site
Faqs.unservablePageBody: A published page carries this topic as its key, but the site serves no address at that page's slug — so nobody can reach these questions. Move the page to one of the addresses the site serves.

Homepage.addIntro: A new section is created hidden, so you can set it up before anybody sees it.
Homepage.configHint: JSON, and each type accepts exactly one shape. Changing the type above replaces this with that type's example.
Homepage.configMalformed: That configuration is not valid JSON. Check the brackets and quotes.
Homepage.configMismatched: That configuration is not a shape this section type accepts. The example for the type shows what it expects.
Homepage.countsBody: It names {chosen} items, and {renderable} of them can still be shown to visitors.
Homepage.detailIntro: One section: what it is, what it names, and how much of that the public can still see.
Homepage.emptyBody: Nothing has been composed, so the front page shows only the site name. Add a section below; it starts hidden.
Homepage.emptyTitle: The homepage has no sections yet
Homepage.hiddenNotice: The section is created hidden. Show it from its own page once it is set up.
Homepage.invalid: Something in that was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
Homepage.keyHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and underscores — for example home_hero. It identifies the section and is never shown to visitors.
Homepage.keyTaken: Another section already uses that key.
Homepage.listIntro: In the order they appear on the homepage. A hidden section keeps its place and shows nobody.
Homepage.noPublishNotice: Saving does not show or hide the section. Use the buttons further down for that.
Homepage.notAllowed: That is not an allowed value for a homepage section.
Homepage.notConfiguredBody: Its stored configuration is not a shape its type accepts, so the homepage leaves it out. Correct the configuration below.
Homepage.notFoundBody: There is no section at that address, or you do not have permission to read it.
Homepage.notHereBody: Featured content is only what you choose by hand — nothing here reads paid promotions, placements or any ranking. There are no banner strips and no images of any kind, because the site has no media address configured yet. Navigation menus and FAQs are not managed here.
Homepage.notHereTitle: What this section does not do
Homepage.notServedBody: Its type is one the homepage does not serve. A banner strip is the only such type today, because a banner is an image and the site has no media address configured. The section is kept and can be removed.
Homepage.pageIntro: What the site's front page is made of, and in what order. Each section names content rather than copying it, so what the homepage shows always matches what is actually on the site.
Homepage.readOnlyBody: Composing the homepage needs a separate permission from reading it. Ask an administrator if you need it.
Homepage.readOnlyTitle: You can read this section but not change it
Homepage.removeConfirm: Remove this section from the homepage? The content it names is not affected.
Homepage.reorderNotice: Move sections and then save. The order applies to the public homepage.
Homepage.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
Homepage.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
Homepage.skippedBody: Everything it names has been sold, hidden or removed, so the homepage leaves the section out entirely. Choose different content, or hide the section.
Homepage.skippedTitle: This section is shown but renders nothing
Homepage.stateIntro: The only controls that change whether visitors see this section.
Homepage.typesBody: Hero, featured listings, featured categories, featured sellers, latest listings, blog highlights, value propositions and rich text. A banner strip is not offered: a banner is an image, and the site cannot serve one yet.
Homepage.typesTitle: The section types you can add
Homepage.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed.

Navigation.addIntro: A menu is a key, a label and the entries you add to it afterwards.
Navigation.clearArabic: Leave empty to remove the Arabic label.
Navigation.detailIntro: One menu, its entries, and which of them the public is actually shown.
Navigation.emptyBody: Until a menu is created, the public site shows its own plain header and footer.
Navigation.entriesIntro: Top-level entries, with anything that sits under them. A menu is two levels deep at most.
Navigation.keyHint: header, footer or mobile to be placed by the site. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
Navigation.keyTaken: Another menu already uses that key.
Navigation.kindHint: A page, a post or a category is followed live, so unpublishing it removes this entry from the site.
Navigation.listIntro: The three placements the site renders are header, footer and mobile. A menu under any other key is kept and simply never placed.
Navigation.noEntriesBody: A menu with no entries is left out of the public site entirely.
Navigation.notAllowed: That is not an arrangement this menu allows.
Navigation.notFoundBody: No menu here, or none you may open.
Navigation.notHereBody: Banners, FAQs and the locale switch are not arranged here. The locale switch is part of the site itself, and banners wait for an image origin this platform does not have yet.
Navigation.notHereTitle: What this screen does not do
Navigation.notPlacedBody: The site places only the header, footer and mobile menus. This one is kept and arranged here, and no public page renders it.
Navigation.nothingToShowBody: Every entry in this menu points at something the public cannot see, so the site leaves the menu out entirely rather than rendering an empty bar. Check the entries below.
Navigation.pageIntro: What the site’s header, footer and mobile drawer hold. An entry points at a page, a post, a category or a path on this site — it never copies that page’s own title, and it never leaves the site.
Navigation.parentHint: A menu is two levels deep at most, so only top-level entries are offered.
Navigation.pathHint: Relative, starting with one slash — for example /listings. A menu entry can never point off this site.
Navigation.removeEntryConfirm: Remove this entry, and anything under it?
Navigation.removeMenuConfirm: Remove this menu and every entry in it?
Navigation.reorderHint: Move the top-level entries into the order the site should show them, then save.
Navigation.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Try again shortly.
Navigation.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

Platform.pageIntro: What the platform runs on a schedule, whether that schedule still matches what was agreed, and what the transactional outbox is holding. Everything here is read-only: the workers own every write to a job run and to an event.
Platform.runDetailIntro: One recorded run, with the scheduled job it belongs to.
Platform.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Platform.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Platform.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Platform.readOnlyNote: This section is read-only. Jobs and queued events are written only by the platform’s own workers, so there is no retry, cancel, requeue or re-run here — and no route behind one.
Platform.scheduleIntro: Every job the database schedules, with the expression it runs on, the function it calls and the purpose recorded for it.
Platform.workerJobsNote: These are the database’s scheduled jobs. The worker’s repeatable jobs record no run yet, so none of them appears here.
Platform.scheduleEmptyBody: The schedule is empty, which is itself worth looking into.
Platform.problemsNone: The schedule matches the contract: nothing is missing, misscheduled, pointed elsewhere or switched off.
Platform.outboxIntro: Every business side effect starts as a committed row here. Counts and ages only — no event, no payload and nothing identifying what any event is about.
Platform.noRelayNote: No relay and no sweeper are running yet, so nothing drains this queue: a large pending count and an old oldest-pending time are expected here and are not a relay failing.
Platform.deadLettersGroupedNote: Grouped by kind rather than listed: identifying each event would mean naming the order, conversation or account it is about, and there is nothing to act on here.
Platform.runsIntro: Every run the platform has recorded, most recent first.
Platform.uncontractedNote: The schedule no longer names this job, so there is no expression, target or purpose to show. The run itself is kept.
Platform.noMessageNote: The failure text is not shown here. The job runner stores it as a raw database error, which quotes the row that caused it, so it is read from the database rather than from this console.

Reviews.queueIntro: Reviews buyers left on completed orders, newest first. A decision recorded here is final: the automatic reassessment that hides reviews on refunded or disputed orders leaves a review a person has ruled on alone.
Reviews.detailIntro: What was written, what state it is in, and the seller’s answer beside it.
Reviews.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Reviews.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Reviews.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Reviews.failed: That could not be recorded. Try again.
Reviews.conflict: This review has changed since the page loaded. Reload it and look again.
Reviews.signedOut: The session has ended. Sign in again.
Reviews.moderatedByMeHint: You recorded the last decision on this review.
Reviews.isPartyHint: You are a party to this review, so somebody else has to rule on it.
Reviews.isPartyNote: You are the buyer or the seller on this review. A colleague who is not a party has to rule on it.
Reviews.isPartyRefusal: Nobody rules on a review they are a party to. A colleague has to take this one.
Reviews.replyReadOnlyNote: Shown so the whole exchange can be read. A reply’s own state cannot be changed from this console.
Reviews.replyGapNote: Hiding or removing a review also hides the seller’s reply, because a reply is public only while its review is. There is no way to act on a reply alone yet.
Reviews.decisionIntro: Every decision is recorded with its reason, and a decision stands: after one is recorded, a refund or a dispute on the order no longer hides the review.
Reviews.decisionStatusLabel: Where this review should end up
Reviews.reasonHint: Kept with the review. Required for every decision, including re-affirming the state it is already in.
Reviews.confirmPublish: Publish this review? It counts towards the storefront’s rating again, and a refund or dispute on the order will no longer hide it.
Reviews.confirmHide: Hide this review? It stops counting towards the storefront’s rating, and the seller’s reply goes with it.
Reviews.confirmRemove: Remove this review? It stops counting towards the storefront’s rating, and the seller’s reply goes with it.
Reviews.confirmPending: Send this review back for moderation? It stops counting towards the storefront’s rating while it waits.

SeoMetadata.addIntro: Choose a surface and a language, then write only the fields you want to replace what it derives.
SeoMetadata.canonicalHint: Used for a static page and a landing route only. Stored for the others and not served.
SeoMetadata.canonicalIgnoredBody: A listing, a category and a seller keep their own address. The value is kept in case the rule changes, and it reaches nobody today.
SeoMetadata.canonicalIgnoredTitle: This canonical is stored and not served
SeoMetadata.cursorBody: That page could not be read. Go back to the first page.
SeoMetadata.detailIntro: One override: what was stored, and what a visitor's browser will actually be told.
SeoMetadata.directivesHint: Only the restricting ones take effect. “index” and “follow” are accepted and do nothing.
SeoMetadata.directivesNarrowedBody: Only the restricting ones take effect, so a stored “index” or “follow” cannot widen indexing past a rule that already restricts it.
SeoMetadata.directivesNarrowedTitle: Some of these directives do nothing
SeoMetadata.effectiveNone: Nothing — this surface keeps what it derives
SeoMetadata.emptyBody: Every surface is showing the metadata it derives from its own content.
SeoMetadata.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
SeoMetadata.kindHint: A service is written as a listing: the two share one table.
SeoMetadata.listIntro: Newest edit first. A surface with no override here keeps the metadata it derives from its own content.
SeoMetadata.noMatchesBody: No override matches that kind or language. Clear the filters to see them all.
SeoMetadata.notAllowed: That is not an allowed override. Both addresses must be paths on this site, every field has a length limit, and the directives must not contradict each other.
SeoMetadata.notFoundBody: There is no such override, or it is not one you may open.
SeoMetadata.notHereBody: Structured data is stored but not yet served. Site-wide defaults are elsewhere. A service is written as a listing, because the two share one table.
SeoMetadata.notHereTitle: What this screen does not cover
SeoMetadata.notWritableBody: It points at a kind of content that has no public page yet. You can read it and remove it.
SeoMetadata.notWritableTitle: This one cannot be rewritten here
SeoMetadata.pageIntro: The title, description and social card a surface shows a crawler, where you want something other than what it derives from its own content.
SeoMetadata.readOnlyBody: Changing the metadata overrides needs a separate permission.
SeoMetadata.readOnlyTitle: You may read this, not change it
SeoMetadata.removeConfirm: Press again to remove it. The surface goes back to what it derives.
SeoMetadata.removeFailed: The override could not be removed.
SeoMetadata.removeIntro: Removing it returns the surface to the metadata it derives from its own content. The audit trail keeps what the override said.
SeoMetadata.replaceWarning: Saving replaces the whole override. A box you leave empty clears that value.
SeoMetadata.routeHint: A fixed address on this site, beginning with a slash — for example /listings.
SeoMetadata.rulesBody: A canonical address is used for a static page and a landing route only — a listing, a category and a seller keep their own address, whatever you store. And the robots directives can only ever restrict: a stored “index” never overrides a rule that already says noindex, such as a sold listing, a suspended seller or a filtered category page.
SeoMetadata.rulesTitle: Two rules worth knowing before you write one
SeoMetadata.saveFailed: The override could not be saved.
SeoMetadata.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
SeoMetadata.shareMediaHint: The identifier of an image already uploaded to site content.
SeoMetadata.targetHint: The surface's identifier, as the catalogue or the pages screen shows it.
SeoMetadata.targetUnknown: That language or that image does not exist.
SeoMetadata.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

SeoRedirects.activateConfirm: Press again to switch it on. Visitors to that address will be sent elsewhere immediately.
SeoRedirects.activeHint: Leave this unticked to add the entry without it redirecting anybody yet.
SeoRedirects.chainBody: A visitor takes more than one hop. Pointing this entry straight at the final address is faster and easier to follow.
SeoRedirects.createFailed: The redirect could not be added.
SeoRedirects.createIntro: Both addresses are paths on this site. A new entry starts switched off, so you can check it before it affects anybody.
SeoRedirects.cursorBody: That page of the map could not be read. Go back to the first page.
SeoRedirects.detailIntro: One entry: where it points, whether it is switched on, and where its chain actually ends.
SeoRedirects.editFailed: The changes could not be saved.
SeoRedirects.emptyBody: No redirect has been added yet. Addresses that no longer exist answer 404.
SeoRedirects.fromHint: A path on this site, beginning with a slash — for example /old-offer.
SeoRedirects.fromRenameHint: Changing this frees the old address, which then goes back to being a 404.
SeoRedirects.invalid: Check the addresses and try again.
SeoRedirects.listIntro: Newest edit first. An entry that is switched off is kept and audited and redirects nobody.
SeoRedirects.loopBody: Following it comes back to the address it started from, so the site ignores it rather than sending a visitor round in circles. Change the destination.
SeoRedirects.noMatchesBody: No entry matches that search or that state. Clear the filters to see the whole map.
SeoRedirects.notAllowed: That is not an allowed redirect. Both addresses must be paths on this site, they must differ, and the status code must be 301, 302, 307 or 308.
SeoRedirects.notFoundBody: There is no such entry, or it is not one you may open.
SeoRedirects.noteClearHint: Clearing this field removes the note.
SeoRedirects.pageIntro: Where an address that no longer exists sends a visitor. Every entry is a path on this site pointing at another path on this site.
SeoRedirects.pathTaken: Another redirect already starts from that address. Edit that entry instead of adding a second one.
SeoRedirects.precedenceBody: The site answers a live page, listing, service or static page itself. An entry is only consulted for an address that would otherwise be a 404, so a redirect from an address that still works will appear to do nothing.
SeoRedirects.readOnlyBody: Changing the redirect map needs a separate permission.
SeoRedirects.readOnlyTitle: You may read this, not change it
SeoRedirects.removeConfirm: Press again to remove it. This cannot be undone from here.
SeoRedirects.resolvedNone: Nowhere — this entry redirects nobody as it stands
SeoRedirects.searchHint: Matches either address, as plain text. A percent sign or an underscore matches that character.
SeoRedirects.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
SeoRedirects.stateHeading: Switch it on, off, or remove it
SeoRedirects.stateIntro: Switching off stops the redirect and keeps the entry. Removing it cannot be undone from here, although the audit trail keeps what it said.
SeoRedirects.statusHint: 301 and 308 are permanent and are what search engines act on. 302 and 307 are temporary.
SeoRedirects.toHint: Another path on this site. A query string is allowed. Addresses on other sites are not.
SeoRedirects.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

SeoSettings.badJson: The organization document must be a JSON object.
SeoSettings.defaultMetaDescriptionHint: Up to 320 characters. Stored only — no page uses it as a fallback yet.
SeoSettings.defaultMetaTitleHint: Up to 70 characters. Stored only — no page uses it as a fallback yet.
SeoSettings.emptyBody: The marketplace has no active language, which should not happen. Nothing can be authored here until one is active.
SeoSettings.invalid: Something in the form is not valid. Nothing was changed.
SeoSettings.mediaMissing: The share image identifier does not match an uploaded media item.
SeoSettings.notAllowed: One of the values is not allowed. Check the lengths and the social handle's format.
SeoSettings.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for your account.
SeoSettings.pageIntro: The site-wide defaults that belong to the whole marketplace rather than to one page, kept per language. Only the robots.txt body is served today; everything else here is stored and waiting for a separate decision.
SeoSettings.removeConfirm: Delete every stored SEO default for this language? If it is the default language, /robots.txt goes back to the minimal document straight away.
SeoSettings.removeFailed: The settings could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.
SeoSettings.removeIntro: Removes everything stored for this language. Nothing public changes, because none of these fields is served for a language that is not the default one.
SeoSettings.removeIntroServed: Removes everything stored for this language, including the robots.txt body. /robots.txt will go back to serving the minimal default document immediately.
SeoSettings.replaceWarning: Saving replaces everything for this language. A field left empty is cleared — which is also how a robots.txt body is withdrawn without deleting the language's settings.
SeoSettings.robotsHint: Served to crawlers exactly as written, line for line. Leave it empty to serve the minimal default document instead. The Sitemap line is added by the site and is not typed here.
SeoSettings.robotsNotServedNotice: This body will not be served. /robots.txt reads the default language's body only. What is typed here is saved and audited, and no crawler will ever see it.
SeoSettings.robotsServedElsewhere: This is not the default language. A robots.txt body saved here is kept and is never served: /robots.txt is a single document at the root of the site and it reads the default language's.
SeoSettings.robotsServedHere: This is the default language, so the robots.txt body below is the one served at /robots.txt.
SeoSettings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
SeoSettings.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
SeoSettings.shareMediaHint: The identifier of an uploaded media item. Stored only, and it cannot be previewed: the media bucket is private and this platform has no way to address an image yet.
SeoSettings.shareMediaUnresolvableBody: This image cannot be resolved or displayed. The media bucket is private and this platform has no media origin or signed-URL capability yet, so only the identifier and its path can be shown.
SeoSettings.siteNameHint: Required. Up to 120 characters. Stored only — the header and page titles do not read it.
SeoSettings.storedOnlyBody: The site name, default title, default description, social handle, share image and organization document are all saved, audited and editable — and nothing reads them yet. The site name does not change the header or any page title, the defaults do not fill a page's metadata, no social tag is emitted, and no structured data is published. Each of those is a separate change somebody has to decide on.
SeoSettings.storedOnlyTitle: The other fields are stored and not yet used
SeoSettings.structuredDataHint: A JSON object. Stored only: nothing publishes it, and what belongs in it has not been decided. Leave it empty if you are unsure.
SeoSettings.twitterSiteHint: An @ followed by up to fifteen letters, numbers or underscores. Stored only — no social tag is emitted.
SeoSettings.unauthoredBody: Fill in a site name and save to create it. Until then this language has no stored defaults at all.
SeoSettings.unauthoredTitle: Nothing is saved for this language
SeoSettings.unavailable: The settings could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
SeoSettings.whatIsServedBody: The robots.txt body is served to crawlers exactly as it is written here, and a change takes effect without a deployment. It is the only field on this screen that anything reads.
SeoSettings.whatIsServedTitle: What on this screen reaches the public

ListingAnalytics.pageIntro: What the daily rollup recorded for each listing, newest day first. Every number here was computed by a scheduled job.
